topics.name: Aggregate Method in Amortized Analysis
topics.description: Analyzing a sequence of operations (e.g., incrementing a binary counter) by computing total cost over n operations and deriving average (amortized) cost per operation.

topics.name: Potential Method for Amortized Analysis
topics.description: Defining a potential function to capture pre‑paid work, calculating amortized cost as actual cost plus change in potential, and applying it to data structure operations.

topics.name: Asymptotic Notations (Big‑O, Θ, Ω)
topics.description: Formal definitions, interpretation of upper, tight, and lower bounds, and how to use them to classify algorithm running times.

topics.name: Growth‑Rate Comparison of Algorithms
topics.description: Using asymptotic notation to compare linear, quadratic, exponential, and logarithmic running times; interpreting tables that list algorithm runtimes for increasing input sizes.

topics.name: Summation Formulas for Time‑Complexity Analysis
topics.description: Common series such as Σ1 = n, Σi = n(n+1)/2, Σi², and geometric series; applying them to derive closed‑form bounds for loops and nested loops.

topics.name: Solving Recurrences by the Iteration (Expansion) Method
topics.description: Unfolding a recurrence step‑by‑step, using summation formulas to obtain a closed form, and verifying the solution with induction.

topics.name: Master Theorem for Divide‑and‑Conquer Recurrences
topics.description: Identifying the parameters a, b, and f(n) in T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n), applying the three cases of the theorem, and determining asymptotic bounds.

topics.name: Time‑Complexity of Simple Loop Constructs
topics.description: Analyzing single and nested for‑loops, distinguishing between O(n), O(n²), and O(log n) patterns, and relating loop bounds to the summation formulas.
